This is the modeling target: OMIE day-ahead hourly clearing price for delivery hour t. All 24 hours of delivery day D are cleared in one auction on D-1 (gate typically 12:00 CET). The same-hour value is unknown at forecast origin and must not enter X. Prior-auction lags (t-24, t-48, t-168) are discussed in the audit; they are not this column as stored.
Realized/intraday-style price at delivery hour t. Observed during or after t, after the day-ahead auction. Distinct from price day ahead (not a copy). Project rule: never a feature, including lags.
